questions.stem: A 30- year old male patient presents with complaints of weakness in right upper and both lower limbs for last 4 months. He developed digital infarcts involving 2nd and 3rd fingers on right side and 5th finger on left side; On examination, at was 160/140 mm Hg, all peripheral pulses were palpable and there was asymmetrical neuropathy. Investigations showed Hb-12 gm. TLC­12000 cumm, platelets 4,30,000, ESR-49mm. Urine examination showed proteinuria and RBC 10-15/hpfwith no casts. which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
